sourceText: User asked to start development from docs/requirements/decisions/source-lineage-dedup-playbook-seed-promotion-execution-plan.md after agreeing that source lineage/dedup audit should precede seed promotion and automatic promotion.
normalizedOutcome: Implement the first safe milestone: a host-neutral, read-only learning source lineage audit command that reports duplicate and missing lineage without mutating learning stores or enabling candidate creation/promotion.
acceptanceClaim: B-01df is complete when source_lineage_audit --domain=learning --json is implemented, classified read-only/L0, covered by smoke tests, and docs clearly state M1 excludes seed proposal, candidate approval, auto-promotion, and DONE settlement default-on.
